title: English contribution policy checks every new commit using trusted policy
steps: Run node --test scripts/test/check-english-commits.test.mjs scripts/test/check-language-policy.test.mjs scripts/test/ci-public-repo.test.mjs from the repository root.
Inspect the TAP totals and exit status; the fixtures create isolated Git repositories and do not need a running application.
expect: Exit status is 0, all tests pass and none are skipped.
Foreign text in new docs, tests, markup, commit messages and PR metadata is rejected; decomposed Unicode and recognizable ASCII phrases do not bypass the check.
Intermediate reverted changes and merge messages are checked; editing the candidate policy does not authorize an exception.
English changes and narrow reviewed translation data pass; invalid UTF-8, missing history and changed opaque objects fail closed.
The workflow uses read-only permissions, a GitHub-hosted runner and base validator code, with no contributor code execution or private submodule checkout.
fence: Trusted-base language-policy PR check plus required CODEOWNERS review and branch protection after publication.
